label: Custom and tikanga
text: LA.O.A1.3 Custom and tikanga — in New Zealand, the Supreme Court in Ellis v R (2022) held that tikanga Māori forms part of the common law, as a source to be applied with care (UNVERIFIED wording; Māori-led review required). The tikanga itself, as tradition-internal law, is owned by IK.

warrant.standard: valid source under the system's recognition rule
warrant.defeaters: repeal, inconsistency with a higher source
